microset: Omega_s=A_s union B_s from the frozen C_s protocol, |Omega_s|=s^2
exact_event_theorem: shell m is present in the C_s dual boundary iff F_C(r,m,s)<=0

proof_components.support_pair: edge support on a>=b reduces exactly to majority selection of T_m at the balanced shell point
proof_components.balanced_optimality: the lower-majority Q order statistic is minimized at the balanced shell triangle
proof_components.monotonicity: the event is initial in m; hence M_C_s(r)=max{m:F_C(r,m,s)<=0}
proof_components.no_ledger: K_s is evaluated from the exact microcentroid rule, not a precomputed C table

tangent_halfspace_lemma.statement: For every s>=1 and every balanced T_m, strictly fewer than s^2/2 microcentroids lie on the inward side of the Q-tangent through the macrotriangle centroid c_m.
tangent_halfspace_lemma.odd_shell: for m=2k+1 the tangent weights reduce to (-2,1,1) in barycentric composition coordinates.
tangent_halfspace_lemma.even_shell: for m=2k the tangent weights are (-6k+1,3k-2,3k+1).
tangent_halfspace_lemma.composition_layers: A_s corresponds to p0+p1+p2=s-1 and B_s to p0+p1+p2=s-2; additive residue constants cancel because the tangent weights sum to zero.
tangent_halfspace_lemma.large_s_bound: N_k(S)<=25*S^2/108+13*S/12+1. Summing S=s-1,s-2 leaves half-sample deficit s^2/27-7s/9+5/54>0 for every s>=21.
tangent_halfspace_lemma.small_s_certificate: for 1<=s<=20 exact composition enumeration checks k=1..13; for S<=19 every sign is stable for k>=13 because any crossing has |k|<=2S/3<13. The worst inward count remains strictly below s^2/2.

previous_shell_lemma.statement: If the N limiting centroid c_m is inside radius r and m>=2, then every point of T_{m-1} is inside radius r, so C_s necessarily contains shell m-1 for every s.
previous_shell_lemma.baseline_case: T_r is wholly inside Q<=r^2 because all its nonnegative vertices satisfy x+y<=r.
